# Phase One — Boundless Completion Brainstorm

The Awtsmoos recreates every finite vessel each instant. This wave treats Geelooy as one living system: discovery, activation, value, commerce, retention, safety, performance, observability, accessibility, recovery, and continuation must reinforce one another.

## Immediate high-leverage fronts
- Prove the entire current release gate after the corrected catalog generator and canonical-route test.
- Prove production-faithful commerce/Radiance behavior in a fresh mobile browser.
- Run an isolated full server and use startup-stage timing to identify the pre-bind bottleneck.
- Re-read every file touched in the current SEO/readiness/telemetry/startup wave and compare planned vs actual behavior.
- Audit git status and overlapping concurrent edits before any additional source rewrite.
- Discover existing recents/favorites/resume infrastructure before creating parallel state systems.
- Discover existing workflow handoff/export/import infrastructure before inventing new cross-product APIs.
- Discover product-specific paid-action opportunities only where fulfillment already exists or can be implemented honestly.
- Discover wallet reconciliation/observability gaps around reservations, commits, releases, expirations, and replay.
- Discover accessibility/performance regressions on shared global commerce/catalog surfaces.
- Discover public product pages with weak authored copy despite catalog-derived SEO fallbacks.
- Discover dead or stale catalog records, aliases, redirects, orphan routes, and duplicate human-facing identities.
- Discover unverified game monetization paths and keep them cosmetic/non-pay-to-win.
- Discover creator/developer monetization paths that add real compute/storage/automation value instead of artificial limitations.

## Revenue-quality principle
No engineering can guarantee millions. The system should maximize sustainable probability through real value, truthful discovery, low-friction activation, transparent paid capability, durable ownership, reliable fulfillment, privacy-safe learning, and retention loops.
